📖 Game script

Jalon Daniels makes his first start for Tampa Bay with Baker Mayfield out (173+ passing; Sean Koerner likes his rushing, +380 to score). Green Bay runs for only 48.7 yards a game, so Jordan Love throws (239+; Brandon Anderson over 241.5) to Christian Watson (67+) and Matthew Golden (58+) on a MEDIUM grade. The Packers are without Micah Parsons (out) and two interior linemen. Tampa Bay's targets are Emeka Egbuka (39+), Chris Godwin Jr. and Cade Otton on another MEDIUM grade. It's 87°F at kickoff. Green Bay by five, covering −3, in a 37-point game, under 39.5.

🧠 Why the card leans this way

This is the biggest move on the slate: TB went from −2.5 at the Action Network open to +3, and the total from 46 to 39.5. The named picks lean TB: Chad Millman (+3.5 home dog), Brandon Anderson (+3.5 contest pick) Action Network (TB moneyline in a dog parlay) and Wes Reynolds of VSiN (TB +9.5 as a teaser leg). The GB picks are Mike Florio (Packers 21–13) and Andrew Erickson, who lists an alternate GB −9.5 while saying his "real lean is the under," so the GB projection goes against the expert majority; Millman and Anderson both took +3.5, half a point better than now. Under: Steve Fezzik (39.5), Josh Shepardson of Sharp Football (38.5, a best bet) and Erickson's lean (38.5); Dave Tuley passes. Evan Abrams' primer splits on the side: two systems play on Green Bay after a 20-point loss, one on Tampa Bay as a winless team. Splits: TB has 53% of tickets and 49% of the money, no gap; 67% of tickets are on the over even after the total fell 6.5 points. The lean is the under 39.5, with GB −3 only while it stays at 3. The projected 37 is 2.5 under the total. Card: Single GB-TB Under 39.5 ($10), and a Jalon Daniels interception is in the 7a Morning prop stack. GB −3.5 is a SuperContest alternate.

⚠️ What breaks it

Daniels' scrambling extends drives the market hasn't priced. Green Bay's turnover margin is −2; a short field or a defensive touchdown breaks the under on its own. A long Watson touchdown early forces the Bucs to throw more than this script assumes.
